title: Paternity Leave

eligibility.who: Fathers: 8 days of paid leave for the birth of a child; may take over the mother's maternity leave if she returned to work

text: Fathers are entitled to eight (8) days of paid leave for the birth of a child. Fathers can also acquire leave from the mothers’ maternity leave if she has returned to work. In order to do this, a father must submit a request to Head of Representative Office and provide a copy of the child’s birth certificate, a document confirming family ties, and a certificate from the mothers’ place of employment confirming her return to work.
